race.comment: HALF MOON ROO (16) is hard to go past after a strong start to the prep here. The wide draw is the only query but she should be hitting her straps now and with a touch of luck she can get the job done. DECORATIVE (8) has to rebound from a poor first-up performance, but she did have excuses after jumping awkwardly and racing wide. A comfortable trial win between runs suggests she can go much better second-up, and Thompson's booking is a big push. GROENING (15) is lightly raced and has more to offer after getting off the mark last start at Rocky. Wiggins sticking is a plus. SALCHOW (7) was too bad to be true first-up and is one to keep in mind.
